datasetId.title: Audit dataset
datasetId.description: The dataset produced by an audit run. Each item is expected to carry riskLevel and issueCodes; anything else is counted as unreadable rather than treated as clean. This Actor asks for read access only — it never writes back into your audit results.

githubConnector.title: GitHub connector
githubConnector.description: An MCP connector authorized against GitHub. This Actor can only read issues and open them; the proxy rejects every other tool, whatever else the connector supports.

owner.title: Issue tracker owner
owner.description: Owner of the repository the issues are filed in. This is the tracker, not the audited project.

repo.title: Issue tracker repository
repo.description: Repository the issues are filed in.

minRiskLevel.title: File issues from this risk level up
minRiskLevel.description: Rows below this level are left in the dataset. A row whose only finding is not_checked is never filed at any setting, because 'could not verify' is not a defect.

maxIssues.title: Maximum issues to open in one run
maxIssues.description: A ceiling on writes. Findings beyond it are reported as deferred, not dropped silently.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Do everything except the write: read the tracker, decide what would be opened, and report it. Leave this on for the first run against a repository you care about.

labels.title: Labels to put on new issues
labels.description: Applied only if the label already exists in the tracker; the Actor does not create labels.
